output.summary: A genus of perennial tropical herbs native to the New World tropics from Mexico and the West Indies south to Argentina. Straight stems carry alternate leaves patterned with white spots and flecks, and many species tolerate shade as houseplants. Chewing the leaves exposes needle-shaped crystals that can cause oral burning, numbness and swelling, sometimes temporarily preventing speech.
output.edibilityNote: Chewing or ingesting leaves exposes needle-shaped calcium oxalate crystals, causing oral burning, numbness, drooling and swelling; severe throat exposure may impede breathing.
